episodes.title: Haunted Forest
episodes.summary: The Red Wolf Squadron joins the battle on the European front to reclaim Cluj-Napoca. Later, Captain Solari notices something amiss.

episodes.title: Broken
episodes.summary: With the battle lost, an injured Captain Solari retreats with Dr. Kasuga and Lieutenant Lesean. They regroup with an infantry unit and plan an escape.

episodes.title: Junkyard
episodes.summary: Awakening from a nightmare, Captain Solari finds the base in ruins. She later rallies weary mechanics to assemble Zaku II units from spare parts.

episodes.title: Night Caller
episodes.summary: With scrappy Zaku II units, Captain Solari and Lesean mount a strong defense against the Federation mobile suits. Later, an unexpected visitor arrives.

episodes.title: The River
episodes.summary: Captain Solari's convoy ambushes an EFF vehicle, but a Zeon patrol jeopardizes the mission before they can reach the outpost.

episodes.title: Convoy to Oblivion
episodes.summary: While Captain Solari struggles with survivor's guilt, the convoy is attacked. She decides to stay behind to secure an escape route to the spaceport.
